# BrowserFS

`browserfs.min.js` is the compatible distribution from the official pygame-web
archive: https://pygame-web.github.io/archives/0.8/browserfs.min.js

It is bundled locally because the default pygbag 0.9.3 template references a
missing CDN file. This avoids a failed runtime dependency request.

BrowserFS is by John Vilk and contributors. The MIT license and bundled dependency
notices are in `BrowserFS-LICENSE.txt`, from the upstream v1.4.3 release:
https://github.com/jvilk/BrowserFS/blob/v1.4.3/LICENSE
